resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because de-duplication returned unique candidates that were neither confirmed as true duplicates nor cleared as false positives, and none of them matched the applicant on face. The applicant was not whitelisted, so the outstanding matches stood.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment, which requires the biometrics to match no existing record at all. Candidates were returned within the permitted limit and none were cleared or confirmed, so global uniqueness could not be established and the packet was rejected with the matched records holding an Aadhaar suspended. A new packet with a careful, complete biometric capture is required to resolve the outstanding matches.
